title: 0035. Codex CLI replaces local qwen3-32b for semantic extraction (Phase 5) and critic review (Phase 7)
summary: Moves semantic extraction (Phase 5) and critic review (Phase 7) from local qwen3-32b to Codex CLI scripts, after deterministic JSON defects in the local route.
notes: Status is Accepted but partially superseded by ADR 0038 (dual-route reachability clause no longer holds); locked is set from the Accepted status as written.
